import java.util.Scanner;
import java.util.regex.Matcher;
import java.util.regex.Pattern;

public class Solution {
    private static int countWords(String text) {
        int count = 0;
        for (String word : text.split("_")) {
            if (!word.isEmpty()) {
                count++;
            }
        }
        return count;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = in.nextInt();
        in.nextLine();
        String line = in.nextLine();

        Pattern pattern = Pattern.compile("\\([^)]*\\)");
        Matcher matcher = pattern.matcher(line);
        StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder();
        boolean[] covered = new boolean[line.length()];
        int insideWords = 0;

        while (matcher.find()) {
            String block = matcher.group();
            for (int i = matcher.start(); i < matcher.end(); i++) {
                covered[i] = true;
            }
            insideWords += countWords(block.substring(1, block.length() - 1));
            matcher.appendReplacement(out, "_");
        }
        matcher.appendTail(out);

        for (int i = 0; i < line.length(); i++) {
            if (line.charAt(i) == '(' && !covered[i]) {
                throw new StringIndexOutOfBoundsException(line.length());
            }
        }

        int maxOutside = 0;
        for (String word : out.toString().split("_")) {
            if (!word.isEmpty() && word.length() > maxOutside) {
                maxOutside = word.length();
            }
        }

        System.out.println(maxOutside + " " + insideWords);
        in.close();
    }
}

    private static int maxWordLength(String text) {
        int max = 0;
        for (String word : text.split("_")) {
            if (!word.isEmpty() && word.length() > max) {
                max = word.length();
            }
        }
        return max;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = in.nextInt();
        in.nextLine();
        String line = in.nextLine();

        StringBuilder out = new StringBuilder();
        int insideWords = 0;
        int pos = 0;
        int originalLength = line.length();

        while (true) {
            int open = line.indexOf('(', pos);
            if (open == -1) {
                out.append(line.substring(pos));
                break;
            }

            out.append(line, pos, open);
            out.append('_');

            int close = line.indexOf(')', open + 1);
            if (close == -1) {
                throw new StringIndexOutOfBoundsException(originalLength);
            }

            insideWords += countWords(line.substring(open + 1, close));
            pos = close + 1;
        }

        System.out.println(maxWordLength(out.toString()) + " " + insideWords);
        in.close();
    }
